paragraphs: Mentioned in Tanchuma under the supplied locator שרה־ו. Even when he (an old man) hears a bird’s voice, he thinks they may be thieves. And we find in מ״ר פט״ו־טז the form R. Yehoshua ben Levi b’R. Shalom.

notes.text: The consulted Bamidbar Rabbah paragraph confirms the extended form Yehoshua ben Levi bar Rabbi Shalom. It is preserved beside Levi bar Shalom without adopting an identity merger. A separate Vayikra Rabbah lookup timed out and supplies no evidence.

The birdcall passage appears in Buber Tanchuma, Chayei Sara 7. The number in Hyman’s printed Tanchuma locator awaits visual collation. The consulted Bamidbar Rabbah 15:16 supplies the longer name in a separate occurrence. The rendering b’R. preserves the abbreviated form בר׳.
